_comment: Example run config for serve/server.py --engine strata.
Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with a path on your machine:
<PACK>    the native pack directory built by tools/iq_pack.py
<PROFILE> the expert profile built by tools/make_profile.py
<LOGDIR>  a writable directory for the engine log
<CUDA>    the CUDA bin directory holding the runtime DLLs (e.g. .../cuda/bin/x64)
No --mtp: this model's MTP draft block is not compatible with the runtime-directory
format (see docs/cyber/10-serving.md).  --spec 2 keeps the verify windows, without drafts.
--kv-resident MUST stay 0: a nonzero value makes the engine hand attention only the cells it
made resident and mask the rest, i.e. it drops context (docs/cyber/08-known-issues.md U8).
sampling: the four values the serving path was validated with, aligned with the llama.cpp
